{{Top|leg}}
The '''Senex Lords''' were the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] and powerful rulers of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. During her [[Ismaren plot|search]] for the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'', [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] made overtures to the Senex Lords for their support.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
